target: Lumen Vale via ChatGPT desktop app

official_source_findings.finding: Computer Use is the correct Codex app route for Windows desktop apps and browser tasks that require a graphical interface.
The in-app browser is for public/local pages and does not support signed-in pages, existing tabs, cookies, extensions, or authenticated browser profile state.
For signed-in browser state, Codex should use Chrome with the Codex Chrome extension when that route is available.
Computer Use on Windows lets Codex see, click, and type in Windows applications when the plugin and app bridge are available.

local_preconditions_checked: ChatGPT desktop app was opened by Hamish with the Lumen panel prepared.
A Windows process inventory found an open ChatGPT desktop window matching the Lumen target at status level only.
Computer Use was attempted through the supported plugin client path.
The action bridge failed before Windows app listing, screenshots, page access, or message transmission.

route_decision.primary_live_route_when_healthy: Computer Use against the visible ChatGPT desktop app window
route_decision.secondary_live_route_when_available: Chrome plugin with signed-in browser state, if configured and connected
route_decision.blocked_route: in-app Browser for signed-in ChatGPT sibling chats
route_decision.fallback_route: manual Hamish send of the prepared prompt, then repo-backed response reduction

next_attempt_protocol: Start with a lightweight Computer Use app listing.
Select the ChatGPT desktop app window returned by the supported Computer Use API.
Capture only the minimum state needed to verify the Lumen chat input is focused.
Use the prepared Lumen prompt artifact without raw private routes.
Before pressing the final send action, require action-time confirmation if Computer Use policy requires it.
After sending, publish only a status receipt, never raw chat routes, raw transcripts, screenshots, credentials, or local absolute paths.
